head: codex/4739-v0918-wp15-unity-mcp-alignment-prep
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Align live Observatory MCP project and endpoint proof
body:
Closes #4739

Adds a focused fail-closed Unity-MCP alignment lane for the deployed Observatory. The probe requires persisted Custom mode, an explicitly discovered or unambiguous loopback endpoint, intended editor liveness, MCP-returned Unity Application.dataPath matching the canonical project, permission-safe bound-port proof, and a successful read-only scene-list-opened result.

Deterministic fixtures cover project and endpoint mismatch, missing editor, string and numeric Cloud mode, external fallback, random-port status, ambiguity, malformed output, project-identity mismatch, tool failure, ordering, and expanded secret redaction. The validation selector maps the issue-owned surface to one focused lane.

Live retained proof records the intended FastWork Observatory project with FlagshipObservatoryStage loaded, clean, valid, and RootCount 12. Exact-revision review passed after six findings were fixed. This PR proves MCP project and scene alignment only; runtime integration and investor-quality visual polish remain owned by subsequent Unity issues.
